season_clubs_auction_check.name: season_clubs_auction_check
season_clubs_auction_check.value: "futbolsa"."season_clubs"."auction_until" is null or "futbolsa"."season_clubs"."auction_opened_at" is not null

seasons_mm_bp_check.name: seasons_mm_bp_check
seasons_mm_bp_check.value: "futbolsa"."seasons"."mm_quantity_bp" between 0 and 10000 and "futbolsa"."seasons"."mm_match_quantity_bp" between 0 and 10000 and "futbolsa"."seasons"."mm_lot_bp" between 0 and 10000

season_rules_values_check.name: season_rules_values_check
season_rules_values_check.value: "futbolsa"."season_rules"."a_per_point" >= 0 and "futbolsa"."season_rules"."b_per_point" >= 0 and "futbolsa"."season_rules"."promotion_per_share" >= 0 and "futbolsa"."season_rules"."promotion_slots" >= 0 and "futbolsa"."season_rules"."buyback_multiple_bp" >= 0 and "futbolsa"."season_rules"."a_libertadores_bonus" >= 0 and "futbolsa"."season_rules"."a_sulamericana_bonus" >= 0 and "futbolsa"."season_rules"."a_relegation_penalty" >= 0 and "futbolsa"."season_rules"."a_relegation_slots" between 0 and 20

wallets_owner_check.name: wallets_owner_check
wallets_owner_check.value:
("futbolsa"."wallets"."owner_type" = 'user' and "futbolsa"."wallets"."user_id" is not null and "futbolsa"."wallets"."bot_id" is null)
        or ("futbolsa"."wallets"."owner_type" = 'bot' and "futbolsa"."wallets"."bot_id" is not null and "futbolsa"."wallets"."user_id" is null)
        or ("futbolsa"."wallets"."owner_type" = 'treasury' and "futbolsa"."wallets"."user_id" is null and "futbolsa"."wallets"."bot_id" is null)
